[EXPERIMENTAL] List policy exceptions for an organization

## Synopsis

[EXPERIMENTAL] List policy exceptions for an organization.

Lists the organization's active policy exceptions, most recently created first. Pass a
Policy Pack name to list only that Policy Pack's exceptions.

Default output is a human-readable table; pass --output=json for the
full response as a JSON envelope.

```
pulumi policy exception list [policy-pack] [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  pulumi policy exception list
  pulumi policy exception list aws-security --stack web/prod
  pulumi policy exception list --status active --status removed --output json
```

## Options

```
  -h, --help                 help for list
      --org string           The organization to list policy exceptions for
      --output string        Output format. Supported values are: default and json (default "default")
      --policy string        Only list exceptions that name this policy
      --stack string         Only list exceptions with targets in this stack, as <project>/<stack>
      --status stringArray   Only list exceptions with this status: active (default) or removed; may be repeated
```
